address: 47/9 Mu 4, Tha Wasukri, Phra Nakhon Si Ayuthaya, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13000, Thailand
bio: On Ayutthaya-Ang Thong Road, near Wat Phanom Yong, the shredded chicken noodle soup needs no extra seasoning. The tom yum broth is perfectly balanced; chicken is tender, while slow-cooked chicken feet are an option. Available for breakfast and lunch only....
